描述_EN: it is possibly one of the 'kunlun boys' cited in historical records of the tang dynasty (ad 618-907), an ill-defined group from south-east asia, but not of chinese origin. this earthenware tomb figure represents a dark-skinned boy with curly hair, maybe a dancer. figures of this type were buried in graves to accompany the deceased in the afterlife.
描述_ZN: 它可能是唐朝（公元618-907年）历史记录中提到的 "昆仑童子 "之一，这是一个来自东南亚的不明确的群体，但不是中国的。 这个陶器墓的形象是一个皮肤黝黑、头发卷曲的男孩，可能是一个舞者。 这种类型的雕像被埋在坟墓里，陪伴死者来世。
